nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) balances in BasicToken; core token balance ledger mutated by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
uint256 totalSupply_ in BasicToken; total token supply, set once in ZooPromo constructor and read by totalSupply().
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed in StandardToken; ERC20 allowance ledger mutated by approve/increaseApproval/decreaseApproval/transferFrom.
uint256 public constant cap = 100000 * 10**6 in ZooPromo; fixed supply ceiling used as initial totalSupply_.
string public constant name = 'ZOO Promo' in ZooPromo.
string public constant symbol = 'ZX' in ZooPromo.
uint8 public constant decimals = 6 in ZooPromo.
BasicToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): debits msg.sender, credits _to using SafeMath and emits Transfer.
BasicToken.balanceOf(address _owner): view returning balances[_owner].
BasicToken.totalSupply(): view returning totalSupply_.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): moves balances and decrements allowance of msg.sender.
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender): view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address _spender, uint256 _addedValue): additive allowance update via SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint256 _subtractedValue): subtractive allowance update with branch-to-zero and SafeMath.sub.
ZooPromo constructor: sets totalSupply_ = cap, credits deployer balance with cap, emits Transfer from address(0).
ZooPromo.approveAndCall(address _spender, uint256 _amount, bytes _extraData): approves _spender then invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied _spender address.
ZooPromo payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain Ether transfers.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b): overflow-checked addition with assert(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b): underflow-checked subtraction with assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b): overflow-checked multiplication with assert(c / a == b).
SafeMath.div(uint256 a, uint256 b): unchecked but Solidity 0.4.x division safe from overflow; division by zero reverts.
ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval(address from, uint256 _amount, address _token, bytes _data): external callback interface invoked by approveAndCall.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller address used as balance/allowance key and as 'from' argument in the external receiveApproval callback.

External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(_spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, _amount, this, _extraData) to an arbitrary attacker-chosen contract, enabling callback reentrancy / malicious token-hook behaviour.

edges.reason: Parameter a flows into SafeMath.mul where the product a*b is computed.
Parameter b flows into SafeMath.mul where the product a*b is computed.
Local c of mul is derived from multiplication expression inside the function.
Numerator a flows into SafeMath.div division.
Denominator b flows into SafeMath.div division.
Minuend a flows into SafeMath.sub subtraction.
Subtrahend b flows into SafeMath.sub subtraction and the assert(b <= a) check.
Parameter a flows into SafeMath.add addition.
Parameter b flows into SafeMath.add addition.
Local c of add is derived from a + b inside SafeMath.add.

transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply() returns the totalSupply_ state variable.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping for _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for msg.sender.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry.

increaseApproval increments the allowed mapping entry.

Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with cap.
Constructor initialises totalSupply_ with cap.
Constructor reads the constant cap to set the initial supply.
approveAndCall invokes the internal approve() function before the external callback.
approveAndCall transfers control to the attacker-supplied external contract via receiveApproval after granting allowance.
The external unsafe call invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary _spender contract, handing control to untrusted code that may re-enter the token.
Attacker-controlled _spender is the target address of the external callback invocation.
_amount is forwarded into the external receiveApproval callback and can be replayed/reused by a malicious callee.
Arbitrary _extraData bytes are forwarded verbatim to the external callback, enabling crafted reentrant payloads.
